batch_size.name: batch_size
batch_size.source: Selected from {1, 16} on the Fashion-MNIST training-only holdout

clip_exponent.name: clip_exponent
clip_exponent.source: SPADE Eq. (20) permits {C_k} but does not provide a numerical decay exponent

clip_norm.name: clip_norm
clip_norm.source: SPADE Eq. (20) gives no numerical MNIST model-update clipping radius

dataset_name.name: dataset_name
dataset_name.source: Experiment dataset selected by the declared comparison protocol

dimension.name: dimension
dimension.source: Controlled transfer from Reference [20] MNIST: lossy encoding to d=10; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value

dirichlet_alpha.name: dirichlet_alpha
dirichlet_alpha.source: User-required supplemental Dirichlet alpha values 0.3 and 0.6

dp_noise_std.name: dp_noise_std
dp_noise_std.source: Direct SPADE model-release noise; no numerical value is supplied by the paper

eta0.name: eta0
eta0.source: Selected from the preregistered Fashion-MNIST training-only holdout grid

eta_exponent.name: eta_exponent
eta_exponent.source: Controlled transfer from Reference [20] Sec. 5.1 MNIST schedule; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value

graph_probability.name: graph_probability
graph_probability.source: Controlled transfer from Reference [20] Sec. 5.1 MNIST graph probability p=0.3; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value

graph_topology.name: graph_topology
graph_topology.source: Controlled transfer from Reference [20] Sec. 5.1 MNIST connected Erdos-Renyi topology; a common comparison assumption for Fashion-MNIST

initialization.name: initialization
initialization.source: Controlled common equal zero initialization assumption shared fairly by all methods

local_epochs.name: local_epochs
local_epochs.source: DP-FedAvg local epoch count for common outer-round comparison

mu0.name: mu0
mu0.source: Controlled transfer from Reference [20] Sec. 5.1 MNIST smoothing constant; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value

mu_exponent.name: mu_exponent
mu_exponent.source: Controlled transfer from Reference [20] Sec. 5.1 MNIST smoothing exponent; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value

n_clients.name: n_clients
n_clients.source: Controlled transfer of N=31 from Reference [20] Sec. 5.1 MNIST digits 6/7; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value

n_rounds.name: n_rounds
n_rounds.source: Fixed total privacy-budget horizon selected by MNIST stability ablation

negative_class.name: negative_class
negative_class.source: Declared binary task class mapped to -1

pathological_minor_fraction.name: pathological_minor_fraction
pathological_minor_fraction.source: Legacy binary mixed-label pathological option; not used by the reference-consistent profile

pca.name: pca
pca.source: Autoencoder architecture is absent; train-only PCA replacement

positive_class.name: positive_class
positive_class.source: Declared binary task class mapped to +1

privacy_allocation.name: privacy_allocation
privacy_allocation.source: Per-round zCDP allocation policy; total privacy follows SPADE Eqs. (25)-(27)

query_noise_std.name: query_noise_std
query_noise_std.source: Controlled transfer from Reference [20] Sec. 5.1 MNIST query-noise scale; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value

regularization.name: regularization
regularization.source: Controlled transfer of the numerical coefficient from Reference [20] Eq. (21) and Sec. 5.1 MNIST; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value

rho.name: rho
rho.source: Fixed at 1.0; derived beta remained inside the SPADE interval

shared_initialization.name: shared_initialization
shared_initialization.source: SPADE-DFL Algorithm 1 permits a common initial x_i,0; enabled only after empirical validation

sigma_u.name: sigma_u
sigma_u.source: Controlled transfer from Reference [20] Sec. 5.1 MNIST multiplicative-noise scale; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value

target_delta.name: target_delta
target_delta.source: Unified DP comparison uses delta=1e-5 from Reference [24] MNIST

target_epsilon.name: target_epsilon
target_epsilon.source: When positive, sigma is derived exactly from SPADE Eqs. (25)-(27)

tau.name: tau
tau.source: Controlled transfer of tau=2 from Reference [13] Sec. IV; not a direct Fashion-MNIST value
